scope: Qwen-led RGB-only pig instance discovery, grounded attributes, tool-assisted observation and verification; source dataset annotations are not acquired or used

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B official model card
sources.supports: multimodal tool-calling interface; no pig accuracy guarantee

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
sources.supports: box/point grounding and visual tools; family evidence distinct from deployed Qwen3.5-9B

sources.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
sources.supports: local high-resolution evidence acquisition; original search model is not pure prompt engineering

sources.title: Visual Sketchpad: Sketching as a Visual Chain of Thought for Multimodal Language Models
sources.supports: visual artifacts and tool feedback; specialist vision modules are a confound for Qwen-only transfer claims

sources.title: Visual Programming: Compositional Visual Reasoning Without Training
sources.supports: decomposed explicit tool programs and intermediate provenance; not all modules are pure image operations

sources.title: ViperGPT: Visual Inference via Python Execution for Reasoning
sources.supports: separate program generation execution and perception; unrestricted Python is not required by our bounded API design

sources.title: Vision language models are blind
sources.supports: fine spatial/counting reliability requires direct checks; tested older VLMs, not current9B pig parsing

sources.title: CAPTURe: Evaluating Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Occluded Object Counting
sources.supports: counting under occlusion is distinct from known-box classification; amodal pattern inference is not our visible-instance target

sources.title: Three-dimensional surface motion capture of multiple freely moving pigs using MAMMAL
sources.supports: pig surface/part identity and interactions; uses calibrated multi-view cues, not a single-RGB metric reconstruction guarantee

sources.supports: fragmented pig bodies and facility occlusion; supervised method is background evidence only

sources.title: Viewpoint-Aware Pig Posture Recognition author dataset documentation
sources.supports: posture definitions and viewpoint dependence only; no image-specific CSV labels are read

sources.title: SwinePose author repository
sources.supports: anatomical keypoint names and explicit inferred hidden-side labels; no data or annotations downloaded

sources.title: GQA: A New Dataset for Real-World Visual Reasoning and Compositional Question Answering
sources.supports: typed object attribute relation and evidence structure; annotated scene graphs are not available inputs here

sources.title: Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
sources.supports: existence and absent-object checks; do not turn suggestive prompts or self-consistency into truth

sources.title: Qwen-Agent official repository
sources.supports: host executes registered tool calls and returns results; no installation authorized by this reading

sources.title: ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object Detection in Multimodal Large Language Models
sources.supports: zero/multiple object detection differs from single referent grounding; pretrained specialist not adopted

sources.title: DeepEyes: Incentivizing Thinking with Images via Reinforcement Learning
sources.supports: native grounding tool reasoning can be learned; RL results do not prove frozen9B benefits from extra calls

sources.title: Multi-Pig Part Detection and Association with a Fully-Convolutional Network
sources.supports: pig part detection and association, visible landmark ownership; supervised source is not annotation-free9B evidence

sources.title: PACO: Parts and Attributes of Common Objects
sources.supports: object-part-attribute hierarchy; generic object/part annotations are not pig parsing performance
